question: In the comprehensive genomic analysis of rhabdomyosarcoma by Shern et al., what fraction of whole-genome-sequenced tumors carried a receptor tyrosine kinase/RAS/PIK3CA-axis alteration?
gold_notes: 93% (41/44) of WGS RMS tumors had an RTK/RAS/PIK3CA-axis alteration.

rag.answer:
According to the Shern et al. comprehensive genomic analysis, **93% (41/44) of the tumors surveyed by whole-genome sequencing (WGS) carried an alteration affecting the receptor tyrosine kinase/RAS/PIK3CA axis** (PMID:24436047).

The study notes that this common genetic axis can be hijacked through two alternative mechanisms: either by rearrangement of a PAX gene or by accumulation of mutations in genes that are downstream targets of the PAX fusion protein (PMID:24436047).
